d:
The Huawei MatePad Mini is one of the nicest compact tablets I’ve used in a while. It’s insanely light and thin, packs a gorgeous 8.8” 2.5K OLED PaperMatte display, solid speakers, and feels perfect for media consumption, reading, and even game streaming.
It’s not perfect though — Huawei’s software situation still has a few caveats, and native gaming performance isn’t class-leading.
So in this video, let’s take a closer look at the Huawei MatePad Mini and see who this tablet is actually for.
